fusions.name: Reaping Backhand
fusions.desc: Backhands a curved arc ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it and making each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hooked Reach
fusions.desc: Only usable on a target at or below 25% health. Hooks your long arm round an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 24 damage, growing the further it reaches, up to 1.4 times at full reach.

fusions.name: Gleaned Mouthful
fusions.desc: Stuffs a handful of gathered grain into your mouth and restores 16 health. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Every Stalk Counted
fusions.desc: Every time you make a kill, a stack builds on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (12% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
